brief.headline: Revenue rose 26% to 47973 in the Thanksgiving/Black Friday week, but the add-to-cart to checkout step fell to 102.82 from 196.99.
executive_summary: Total revenue was 47973, up 26% from 38086, with transactions at 681, up 21% from 563.
Sessions were 27780, up 7.2%, and users were 22126, up 10.8%, consistent with the US Thanksgiving and Black Friday calendar.
Conversion rate was 1.85, up 28.5% from 1.44, and AOV was 70.44, up 4.1% from 67.65.
The biggest funnel leak was Add to cart -> checkout, which moved to 102.82 from 196.99, a -47.8% change.

what_changed.title: Total revenue and transactions increased
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 47973 vs 38086, +26%; transactions were 681 vs 563, +21%; sessions were 27780 vs 25914, +7.2%.

what_changed.title: Add to cart -> checkout declined
what_changed.detail: Add to cart -> checkout was 102.82 vs 196.99, -47.8%, and is the biggest leak.

what_changed.title: Referral channel converted strongly
what_changed.detail: shop.googlemerchandisestore.com / referral revenue was 13458, +29.4%, with conversion rate 2.97, +62.7%, while sessions were 4949, +0.4%.

what_changed.title: Mobile view-to-cart moved below total
what_changed.detail: Mobile product view to cart rate was 18.64 vs 8.42, +121.5%, with gap_vs_total_pts -16.8; total view-to-cart is flagged for tracking verification.

likely_drivers: The week included US Thanksgiving and Black Friday, likely driving higher sessions, users, and revenue.
New users were 19299, up 12.9% from 17100, consistent with holiday shopping traffic.
The add-to-cart to checkout decline is not explained by the calendar events in the payload and likely needs a checkout or tracking investigation.
risks: If the add-to-cart to checkout step remains at 102.82 vs 196.99, checkout completions may continue to be lost.
If the product view to cart rate is not verified, teams may act on a tracking artifact instead of a demand change.
If new purchasers are not followed up, returning revenue share may remain low at 2.21 vs 3.28.

actions.action: Verify the product view to cart tracking before using it in planning.
actions.why: The total product view to cart rate is flagged as check_tracking true and is not a demand story.
actions.evidence: Product view to cart rate current 19.11, previous 8.02, change_pct 138.4, check_tracking true.

actions.action: Review the add-to-cart to checkout step in the checkout flow and confirm whether the 102.82 vs 196.99 change is a tracking or conversion issue.
actions.why: This step is the biggest leak and a critical risk.
actions.evidence: Add to cart -> checkout current 102.82, previous 196.99, change_pct -47.8, biggest_leak.

actions.action: Create a post-purchase follow-up flow for new purchasers to encourage a second order.
actions.why: New purchasers and new-purchaser revenue rose sharply, while returning revenue share fell.
actions.evidence: New purchasers current 484, previous 352, change_pct 37.5; revenue_from_new current 46840, previous 36903, change_pct 26.9; returning_revenue_share_pct current 2.21, previous 3.28.
